headline: Bulgaria Approves Joint Purchase of Five More German IRIS-T Air Defense Systems
summary: Bulgaria's National Assembly ratified an agreement with Germany to jointly buy five additional IRIS-T SLM systems under the EU's SAFE instrument. The vote was 179 in favour and none against.
why: IRIS-T SLM is a German-made air defence system built by Diehl Defence, and EU-financed joint procurement shapes European defence industrial demand.
